# netbox_tenant_group (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/tenancy/#tenant-groups):

> Tenants can be organized by custom groups. For instance, you might create one group called "Customers" and one called "Departments." The assignment of a tenant to a group is optional.
>
> Tenant groups may be nested recursively to achieve a multi-level hierarchy. For example, you might have a group called "Customers" containing subgroups of individual tenants grouped by product or account team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_tenant_group" "test" {
  name = "test-tenant-group"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the tenant group.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the tenant group.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the tenant group.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the tenant group. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `parent_id` (Number) The ID of the parent associated with the tenant group.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the tenant group.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the tenant group was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the tenant group was last changed.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.
- `tenant_count` (Number) The number of tenant objects that refer to the tenant group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_tenant_group.example 1
```
